ext_description.message: Group your tabs by topic with AI (Claude or local Gemini Nano) or by domain, automatically or manually.
ext_description.description: Extension description shown in chrome://extensions and the Chrome Web Store (max 132 characters).

cmd_groupNow.message: Group the ungrouped tabs of the current window
cmd_groupNow.description: Description of the keyboard shortcut in chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

popup_loading.description: Popup: placeholder while the status loads.

popup_groupNow.description: Popup: primary button, groups the ungrouped tabs.

popup_regroup.description: Popup: button that reclassifies every tab.

popup_regroupTitle.message: Also reclassifies tabs that are already grouped
popup_regroupTitle.description: Popup: tooltip of the "Reorganize all" button.

popup_ungroup.description: Popup: button that removes every tab from its group.

popup_auto.description: Popup: checkbox that toggles automatic grouping.

popup_settings.description: Popup: link to the options page.

popup_processing.description: Popup: shown while an action runs.

popup_error.description: Popup: generic failure when the service worker gives no detail.

provider_nano.description: Provider label in the popup status line.

provider_heuristic.description: Provider label in the popup status line.

status_noResponse.message: No response from the service worker
status_noResponse.description: Popup status: the background did not answer.

status_noRuns.description: Popup status: nothing has run yet.

status_noProvider.message: Not grouped: no provider available for $COUNT$ tabs · $AGO$
status_noProvider.description: Popup status: every provider failed or was skipped.

status_nothingToGroup.message: Nothing to group: no ungrouped tabs · $AGO$
status_nothingToGroup.description: Popup status: the last run found no candidates.

status_lastRun.description: Popup status: summary of the last run.

status_fallback.description: Popup status: a provider failed and the chain fell through.

status_managed.description: Popup status: enterprise policy is present.

status_managedProxy.message: Managed by your organization · corporate proxy
status_managedProxy.description: Popup status: enterprise policy with a proxy endpoint.

status_halfUpdated.description: Popup status: the service worker is older than the popup.

status_claudeNoConsent.message: Claude inactive: accept the data notice in Settings first.
status_claudeNoConsent.description: Popup status: a key exists but the disclosure was not accepted.

status_noEngine.message: In-Chrome grouping has no engine: enable "Domain fallback" or Gemini Nano in Settings.

status_heuristicOnly.message: In-Chrome grouping: by domain (no API key or Gemini Nano).
status_heuristicOnly.description: Popup status: only the heuristic is usable.

status_desktopHint.message: To group by topic, ask Claude Desktop.
status_desktopHint.description: Popup status: appended to status_heuristicOnly when the bridge is connected.

status_claudePaused.message: Claude paused (circuit breaker) after repeated errors.
status_claudePaused.description: Popup status: the Claude circuit breaker is open.

err_breakerOpen.description: Fallback reason: provider skipped because its circuit breaker is open.

err_groupingInProgress.message: A grouping run is already in progress in this window
err_groupingInProgress.description: Error: manual run requested while another one is running.

err_bridgeDisabled.message: The Claude Desktop bridge is disabled in the extension

err_noConsent.message: The user has not accepted the data notice in the extension settings

err_unsupportedMethod.description: Error returned to the bridge host.

err_claudeNoToolUse.description: Error: the model did not call the tool.

err_promptApiBrowser.message: Prompt API not available in this browser
err_promptApiBrowser.description: Error: Gemini Nano download requested without the Prompt API.

err_promptApiContext.message: Prompt API not available in this context
err_promptApiContext.description: Error: Gemini Nano classification without the Prompt API.

opt_managedTitle.description: Options page: banner shown under enterprise policy.

opt_managedBody.message: Locked options are set by IT and cannot be changed here.

opt_disclosureTitle.message: What data is sent and to whom

opt_disclosureBody.message: If you enable Claude (API) or the Claude Desktop bridge, the following is sent to {dest} —or to your Claude Desktop session when you ask it to—: the title, the domain and, if you allow it below, the redacted URL path of your tabs. URL parameters, fragments, page content, cookies and passwords are never sent; emails, IDs and long numbers are masked.
opt_disclosureBody.description: Options page: data disclosure. Keep the {dest} slot (destination name) and the … emphasis markers.

opt_disclosureUse.message: Sole use: deciding which group each tab belongs to. The extension developer does not receive, store or sell any data. Gemini Nano and the domain heuristic run 100% on your device and do not require this consent.
opt_disclosureUse.description: Options page: data disclosure, second paragraph.

opt_consent.message: I understand and agree to send this data to group my tabs.

opt_destAnthropic.description: Options page: destination named in the disclosure (direct API).

opt_destProxy.message: your organization's proxy ($HOST$) and from there to Anthropic
opt_destProxy.description: Options page: destination named in the disclosure (corporate proxy).

opt_proxyInfo.message: Connected through the corporate proxy: the credential lives in your organization's vault, not on this device.
opt_proxyInfo.description: Options page: shown when policy sets a proxy endpoint.

opt_apiKeyHelp.message: Use a dedicated key with a spend limit. It is never synced or sent anywhere other than api.anthropic.com.

opt_apiKeySaved.description: Options page: API key placeholder when a key is stored.

opt_rememberKey.message: Remember the key on this device (otherwise it is cleared when Chrome closes)

opt_enterKey.description: Options page: connection test without a key.

opt_acceptNoticeFirst.description: Options page: connection test without consent.

opt_testing.description: Options page: connection test in progress.

opt_testOk.description: Options page: connection test succeeded; lists the group names returned.

opt_noGroups.description: Options page: connection test succeeded but the model returned no groups.

opt_desktopIntro.message: Lets Claude Desktop, signed in with your own session and without an API key, read your tabs (the same redacted data described in the notice) and group them when you ask. Requires installing the local bridge once.

opt_statusLabel.description: Options page: label before a state value.

opt_bridgeInstallHelp.message: In the bridge folder: node install.mjs --extension-id --configure-claude, then restart Claude Desktop.
opt_bridgeInstallHelp.description: Options page: install hint. Keep the … markers and the command unchanged.

opt_permissionDenied.description: Options page: the nativeMessaging permission was refused.

bridge_notInstalled.message: Host not installed: run the installer

opt_nanoHelp.message: Requires Chrome with the Prompt API and compatible hardware. Skipped when unavailable.

nano_downloadProgress.description: Options page: Gemini Nano download progress.

opt_enableHeuristic.message: Domain fallback if the AI fails

opt_catchAll.message: When grouping manually or with Claude Desktop, put leftover tabs in "$NAME$"
opt_catchAll.description: Options page: checkbox. NAME is the catch-all group title for the selected group-name language.

opt_languageAuto.description: Options page: option of the group-name language select.

opt_sendPath.message: Send the redacted URL path (no query or fragment) for better accuracy

opt_excludedHostsLabel.message: Domains that never leave the device (one per line)

opt_excludedHostsPlaceholder.description: Options page: placeholder of the excluded-domains textarea (one host per line).

opt_excludedHostsHelp.message: Grouped locally by domain. Subdomains included.

opt_policyHosts.description: Options page: hosts excluded by enterprise policy.

opt_locked.description: Options page: tooltip on policy-locked fields.
